tests.name: Effective description
tests.reasoning: The description opens with imperative phrasing ('Use this skill when...'), focuses on user intent (which path AWS will pick, why traffic took an unexpected route), explicitly lists trigger contexts including symptom-based phrasing a user might use without naming the domain ('traffic is leaving the region', 'not using my local Direct Connect', 'routing to the wrong VIF/location', 'path is asymmetric'), and stays within a reasonably concise paragraph despite covering a technically dense domain.
tests.evidence: 'Use this skill when the user wants to know which path AWS will pick for their traffic, why traffic took an unexpected route, or how to make AWS prefer a path. ... Use it even when the user only describes a symptom, such as "traffic is leaving the region", "not using my local Direct Connect", "routing to the wrong VIF/location", or "path is asymmetric".'
